grammar.summary: 本课学习 as...as 结构与 continue 表延续。

points.title: as...as 同级比较
points.explanation: as + 形容词/副词 + as：It obviously could not tell the difference... continued to do 表"持续做"。蛇随音乐摆动的观察描写。

examples.en: We continued to watch the snake.

points.title: tell 表辨别
points.explanation: tell the difference between... = 辨别……之间的区别，tell 此处不是"告诉"。

examples.en: The snake began to sway to the sound of the pipe.
